name: Topological Sort for Cell Projection
aliases: Exact Visibility Ordering for Cell Projection
definition: An O(n) algorithm to sort convex volumes filled with convex polyhedral cells in back-to-front order using a directed graph. Edges connect cells sharing a face, directed towards the cell containing the viewpoint.
summary: MPVO computes exact back-to-front visibility for convex polyhedral grids by topologically sorting occlusion relations, unlike heuristics that lack guaranteed correctness.
